div.div: خُبَعْثِنَةٌ , like قُذَعْمِلَةٌ, Big and strong; (AO, S, K;) applied to a man; and (in like manner, TA) a lion; (K;) and so ↓ خُبَعْثِنٌ , (S, K,) as in the phrase خُبَعْثِنُ الخَلْقِ [big and strong of make]; (AA, S;) and ↓ خَبَعْثَنٌ : (K:) the first is applied as an epithet to a lion by Aboo-Zubeyd Et-Tá-ee: and [the pl.] خُبَعْثِنَاتٌ, by El-Farezdak, to camels. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
